messages:
sam: Heads-up — customer Acme R&D wants us to onboard Sequoia-8B in ONNX format. They need latency under 150ms p50 on Dedicated, and want an int8 path for cost. Can we triage prioritization + checklist? Links: https://acme.example.com/request-123 :wave

anya: Thanks Sam. Do we have the ONNX artifact + sample prompts? Also what's expected throughput? single-request latency or batched? :eyes:

sam: They sent a tarball (S3 link) and sample prompts (~2k prompts). Throughput target is 20 qps bursty with p95 < 300ms. I'll drop link in #vendors. s3://acme-sequoia/sequoia-8b.onnx

jiwon: For int8 path we need to try PTQ first. Can you confirm whether it exports with quantization-friendly ops? If not, QAT might be needed. Est compute: ~2 A100-80h for PTQ calibration + eval. Also need KV cache support in ONNX. :point_up:

devon: I'll add a quick bring-up checklist: 1) smoke load + latency, 2) quant PTQ+eval, 3) quality regression vs baseline (ROUGE/BERTScore + eval set), 4) canary config on Dedicated, 5) rollout + fallback. Assigning myself on smoke. :thumbsup:

anya: Suggest adding failure criteria: >2% drop in BERTScore or >5% user-perc regressions => veto. Also add hallucination rate check with curated probes.

sam: copying customer PM @anya for expectations — they prefer canary to Hosted first then Dedicated. @deploy-bot please create onboarding ticket.

deploy-bot: Created ticket INF-2134 — Sequoia 8B ONNX onboarding. Link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-2134

jiwon: Quick command to run local eval:

```bash
run_eval --model s3://acme-sequoia/sequoia-8b.onnx --prompts sequoia_prompts.json --batch 1 --metrics rouge,bertscore,hallucination --out results.json
```

devon: I'll do the smoke -> ETA EOD tomorrow. If PTQ needs QAT, flag to product for more dev time. :calendar:

anya: Sounds good. Assigning priority P2 for now until smoke results. Will bump to P1 if customer needs enterprise SLA. Thanks.

sam: Thanks all — keeping thread here for updates. :pray:
